penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: US tax filing and amendment advice is a regulated activity (IRS Circular 230). Providing specific tax guidance without a CPA or enrolled agent creates legal/compliance risk.

penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Actual tax amendment preparation for nonresident filers requires case-by-case human review of immigration status, treaty positions, and IRS correspondence — Claude cannot autonomously fulfill this correctly and safely.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Anxious filers facing IRS penalties will generate high support volume requiring human judgment.

rationale: The buyer is real (J-1/F-1 visa holders who already paid for tax software and got it wrong, demonstrating willingness to pay $99–$299 for a correct outcome), and the pain is severe. However, US tax amendment services for nonresidents sit squarely in regulated territory — giving specific tax advice without an enrolled agent or CPA is an IRS Circular 230 violation, and incorrect filings cause real financial harm. Per-case fulfillment is unavoidably human-intensive, and operational autonomy is fundamentally incompatible with the actual value proposition. The penalty stack drops this below viability.
solution_plan: This opportunity is not viable as a solo non-technical factory-run service without a licensed tax professional as a partner. Claude can generate educational content about 1040-NR amendment workflows, but cannot autonomously prepare and certify an individual's tax return — doing so without licensure is legally problematic and would expose Youval to IRS enforcement. Drop unless a licensed enrolled agent or CPA is available to review every output, which changes the economics entirely.
notes: Failing build_gates: operational_autonomy (3 < 7 required), buildability_with_ai (5 < 6 required at margin). regulated_industry penalty is structural.
